svg.title: Direct-repeat recombination
svg.desc: Two parallel ribbons contain directly oriented purple and blue repeat copies enclosing A B ... Y Z. The ribbons fold together, bringing the purple repeat above the blue repeat at one black exchange X. Both open paths pass through A B ... Y Z; the outgoing flanks cross over the right bend without joining it. Recombination produces paired deletion ribbons with a purple-then-blue junction and a separate paired ring retaining A B ... Y Z with a blue-then-purple junction across its top. The source does not identify the molecular or replication state of the paired ribbons. Continuation chevrons are not chromosome termini; no centromere position or length scale is asserted.
